messages.author: Lpresto
messages.content_text:
I cant even explain how textbook of a trade this was, so im taking my time to explain this trade breakdown so I can come back to this post in case I start to question myself and the trades im taking.
If it aint remotely near this one I DONT WANNA SEE IT!!


First of all we tapped into a Higher timeframe PD Array which was a swing low that was resting above an OB.
,


Price gave an initial reaction and I was tempted to enter but we 1. Didnt sweep the 4h CRL and we didnt inverse the FVG. So I sat on my hands.
,


Thirdly there was an opportunity to enter of the RB that formed after we swept the CRL, but I wanted an extra confirmation so I waited for a close above 10am KO and then waited for price to retest that level. Textbook.
,


DOL was simply put STDV which ligned up with another HTF OB:)
,

Patience, patience, patience this is what I sjould be looking for. CRL/H into a HTF PD Array and then use KO, RBs etc as entry criterias.
